commit.message: Another attempt at fixing the selection bug

issues.title: Fix additional window references to owner window
issues.body: Two small ones I missed with my grep 😇

issues.title: Update window references to support editors on multiple windows
issues.body:
I'd like to render a slate editor into a voice and video "popout" window. Discord renders popup windows by calling `ReactDOM.render(<Something>, popoutDocument)`. This leads to all manner of fun editor bugs where the react binding calls `window.getSelection` on the main window global instead of the popout window. This leads to oggersP.

I took the simple way out here of storing the correct window reference as an expando property of the `editor` on construction, and using it in all of the window global references that made sense. What results is a pretty formulaic find and replace with a pretty big blast radius. I'm a bit scared of introducing _new_ bugs, so we'll want to give this a lot of use before rolling out. So far, it seems to work. 🤞

issues.title: Fix iterable length warnings with inline children
Render inline children
issues.body: This is almost a direct copy of the block children renderer, with an extra check for whether this inline's children is interesting at all (contains something more than just a space text node)

issues.title: Add better support for complex imput models like composition/ime/auto-correct/etc
issues.body:
Uses a similar model to editors like etherpad, which let the browser modify the dom, and then incorporates any changes in the browser into the editor's internal data structure.

The before.js plugin has most of the documentation, so I'd probably start there when reading.  I'm also happy to sit down with you in person to go through this one.
